svg.text: A dark mop of hair with a cowlick, a slate-blue roll-neck jumper, charcoal trousers, grey canvas shoes. Soft vector shading, lit from the upper left.
dark oval eyes with one highlight, brows do the acting, a small nose, a short mouth
• the only cool colour in a scene; the Pull is the only warm one
• edges are a darker shade of each colour, never black ink
• silhouette test: hair mop + cowlick + roll-neck read in black
• about 3.7 heads tall: young adult, not a mascot
